Memorandum of May 4, 1972, to the State Clearinghouse from Executive Director, Florida Department of Natural Resources.
Comment: This memorandum endorses the proposed legislation and offers the services of the Department in determing which Florida species should be listed and measures for protection of those species. The communication goes further to ask assurance that private property rights will be protected when endangered species habitat is acquired.
Response: Owners of any habitat that must be acquired by the Department of the Interior for protection and restoration of an endangered species will be offered not less than the fair market value for title to that land.
